name: huayuan-schedule-butler-v2
description: Unifies SCUT undergraduate course schedules, assignments, exams and notices into explainable plans. Every turn opens a guided four-page dashboard in WorkBuddy's side browser with setup red dots, copyable onboarding actions, University Town routes, all todos, campus activities and mobile companion controls.

profession.zh: 华园本科生日程规划助理

displayDescription.en: Unifies SCUT University Town timetables, assignments and campus opportunities into explainable plans. Every turn opens a guided four-page dashboard in WorkBuddy's side browser with setup red dots, copyable onboarding actions, weather-aware routes, all todos, campus activities and mobile companion controls.
displayDescription.zh: 面向华南理工大学大学城校区，聚合多平台课表、作业、考试、校园通知与活动；每轮对话先在 WorkBuddy 右侧浏览器打开带初始化红点和复制补全指令的四页驾驶舱，提供“现在干什么”、临时重排、复习任务、天气感知校园路线和手机工作台控制。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请告诉我你能帮我做什么，并引导我完成首次初始化
defaultInitPrompt.en: Show me what you can do and guide me through first-time setup

quickPrompts.zh: 请告诉我你能帮我做什么，并引导我完成首次初始化
quickPrompts.en: Show me what you can do and guide me through first-time setup

quickPrompts.zh: 我现在该干什么？请给出唯一的第一动作和接下来的安排
quickPrompts.en: What should I do right now? Give me the single next action and the following schedule

quickPrompts.zh: 我要临时加一门课、一项作业或一段休息，请帮我重排本周计划
quickPrompts.en: Add a temporary class, assignment, or rest block, and reschedule my week
